The '''Imperial Social Planning Office''' was an organization of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] that helped [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] plan for their "vital role to play in our new society" during the early [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]].
